Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test, with 4 on hand at a Cost of $12.50, so its stock is worth $50.00 (4 × $12.50).
  • Set part A inactive.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value under PARTS in the left menu), for today at the test location.
